image_description: Two women standing side-by-side wearing black academic gowns and mortarboard caps. The woman on the left holds a white diploma or certificate and makes a hand gesture. The woman on the right has her hands clasped in front of her. Both are smiling. The background is a neutral indoor wall.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the waist/hip level; the 'ankles' and full length are not visible, making full verification impossible. Additionally, the fit appears somewhat fitted rather than purely rectangular due to arm positioning.
Both gowns exhibit the standard center-front opening and general bilateral symmetry expected of academic regalia.

The gowns do not fully obscure body contours; the shape of the arms, shoulders, and torso is clearly visible through the fabric, suggesting a lighter material or tighter fit than the 'voluminous' ground truth describes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeves do not hang freely below the hand level. The subjects are actively using their arms/hands, causing the sleeves to bunch up or drape along the arm rather than exhibiting the characteristic 'bell' hang of a traditional academic gown.
The vertical front panels typical of academic gowns are visible on both subjects.
The area beneath the gown (neckline/chest) is partially visible but does not clearly show distinct formal attire (e.g., collared shirt, tie) due to occlusion and image resolution.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric appears black and relatively matte, consistent with standard gown materials, though some sheen is present on the folds.
The fabric surface is smooth without significant texture or high-gloss reflection.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Due to the active posing of the subjects, the sleeves are pulled back or bunched, failing to demonstrate the passive 'drape past the wrist' characteristic defined in the taxonomy.

artifact_observations.location: Hands and fingers of both subjects
artifact_observations.reasoning: Severe anatomical distortion. The woman on the left has fingers that appear fused, elongated, and misshapen (particularly the pinky and ring finger). The woman on the right has hands where fingers seem to merge into each other or the gown fabric, lacking clear joint definition.

artifact_observations.location: Right subject's hands and gown front
artifact_observations.reasoning: The hands of the woman on the right appear to blend slightly into the black fabric of the gown, with unclear boundaries between skin tone and the dark robe.
The text on the white document is illegible smudges/blobs rather than coherent characters, typical of AI generation failure in rendering small text.
Skin texture is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking natural pore detail, especially around the cheeks and forehead.
